label: REVIEW
jd: Senior AI Engineer: build and own RAG pipelines and vector search, deploy services on Kubernetes, mentor junior engineers.
resume:
Staff Engineer, 8 years
- Designed a vector search service using HNSW indexes in FAISS
- Led the Kubernetes migration of the search service
Skills: Python, Kubernetes, FAISS
transcript:
Interviewer: How did you choose the index type?
Candidate: I chose HNSW over IVF because recall at low latency mattered. I set M to 32 and efConstruction to 200 and validated with recall at k.
Interviewer: What was your role in the Kubernetes migration?
Candidate: I owned it end to end. I wrote the Helm charts and ran the cutover myself.
Interviewer: How do you work with your team?
Candidate: Honestly my teammates slow me down. Code reviews are mostly a waste of time and I skip them when I can. Junior engineers should figure things out themselves.
